# JCAlgTest applet

This directory vendors the Java Card applet portion of
[JCAlgTest](https://github.com/crocs-muni/JCAlgTest) **v1.8.2**, commit
`991c0488418a0efb4bf0acd484f7996e0eaa7bcd`. JCAlgTest is MIT licensed; the
upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Only the ten applet source files and the MicroCard Java Card 3.0.5 build are
included. The desktop client, result database, binary dependencies and Oracle
Java Card SDK are excluded.

MicroCard carries one source change in `JCAlgTestApplet.allocateResources`.
The storage benchmark eagerly constructs both AES and optional DES ciphers.
Its `NO_SUCH_ALGORITHM` exception used to abort delayed allocation, preventing
the independent capability test from reporting a runtime without DES. The
patched applet omits that optional benchmark module when one of its algorithms
is absent. It does not claim that DES is supported.

The CAP was built with upstream's `build305` Ant target and Java 8, using its
Java Card 3.0.5 preprocessing. The checked-in load file was then generated by:

```sh
python3 scripts/jcvm_cap_inventory.py \
  vendor/jcalgtest/jcalgtest-v1.8.2-jc305.cap \
  --load-file crates/microcard-engine-jcvm/tests/vectors
```
